title: St Francis's final Tau

tellings.quote: aisi seeing what was probably a craft or an orb a seraphim and um the last thing he writes in his diary is the Greek letter Tao which uh means conversion

plain: The medieval Italian saint Francis of Assisi saw a seraph, a fiery angel of the Bible, which Jesse Michels says was "probably a craft or an orb", and the last thing Francis wrote in his diary was the Greek letter Tau, which Michels says means conversion. Michels tells this himself, without naming an edition or source for the diary, as a sign that old religious visions may have been encounters with the same things people now call UFOs.
